title: Scaling Transformer Energy-based Models For High Quality Image Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.31889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Energy-Based Models (EBMs) are a flexible class of generative models that decouple probabilistic modeling from the generation process. This decoupling directly enables compositional generation and inference-time scaling, where sample quality can be refined simply by increasing sampling steps. However, severe challenges in high-dimensional sampling and training instabilities with deep architectures have restricted EBMs to low-dimensional regimes. To resolve these bottlenecks, we introduce the Transformer Energy-Based Model (TEM), a scalable transformer energy function operating entirely within a latent space. On top of this backbone, we extract energies at multiple layers and sum them, composing complementary constraints from local texture to global semantics. translated_title: 扩展Transformer能量模型以实现高质量图像合成
translated_abstract: 能量基模型是一类灵活的生成模型，它将概率建模与生成过程解耦。这种解耦直接使组合式生成和推理时扩展成为可能，即只需增加采样步数即可提升样本质量。然而，高维采样中的严峻挑战以及深度架构下的训练不稳定性，一直将能量基模型限制在低维场景中。为解决这些瓶颈，我们提出了Transformer能量基模型（TEM），这是一种完全在潜空间中运行的可扩展transformer能量函数。在此骨干网络之上，我们从多个层提取能量并将其求和，从而组合了从局部纹理到全局语义的互补约束。此外，两个组件使其能够大规模实现高质量生成：正表示对齐，它利用视觉基础模型对TEM的中间表示进行监督……
tldr: 本文提出Transformer能量基模型（TEM），通过在潜空间中运行的可扩展transformer能量函数、多层能量组合以及正表示对齐（PRA）等技术，克服了能量基模型在高维采样与深度架构训练中的瓶颈，实现了高质量的大规模图像合成。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Transformer Energy-Based Model (TEM), which overcomes the bottlenecks of EBMs in high-dimensional sampling and deep-architecture training through a scalable transformer energy function in latent space, multi-layer energy composition, and Positive Representation Alignment (PRA), enabling high-quality large-scale image synthesis.
